$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the overlays (packages/ui: dialog.tsx, sheet.tsx, popover.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx, tooltip.tsx, command.tsx, sonner.tsx, truncated-text.tsx, adaptive.tsx, confirm-dialog.tsx), merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. Every overlay is solid and square: surface-raised, a 1px line-rule, the 2px radius at most, no blur, no shadow. Sizes on the 4px spacing scale (a 44 or 48 close button, a 36 x 4 grabber, a 36px menu row) are Tailwind spacing and the size roles, so they need no knob. This file re-declares four knobs of component.json that the 2026-11 restyle changes: dialog.padding, sheet.handle, sheet.compact-height and popover.width.

padding.$description: The space inside a dialog, at its sides and bottom (Figma: Lockdown D05 and D09, Vale D02 draw 24). A sticky DialogFooter reaches out by it to run edge to edge. Re-declared from component.json, where it was 1rem.

padding-top.$description: The space above the header's overline (Figma: 16 on every drawn desktop dialog). The close button sits 4px lower, centred on the 52px overline and title.

margin.$description: The least space a dialog leaves to the screen's edge on every side. Every size is capped at the screen less twice this, so below a size's width a dialog is as wide as it can be (Synapse SNA5: the viewport less 48px).

question.$description: size="question": a confirmation, a one-field layer, the gate (cross-app decisions §14). Min and max are the drawn width; raise the max to let wide content widen it.

review.$description: size="review": read one thing and answer it (Figma: Lockdown D09, 560).

form.$description: size="form", the default: a form (Figma: Lockdown D05 and Vale D08, 640).

compose.$description: size="compose": writing at length (Figma: Vale D02, 720).

viewer.$description: size="viewer": a diff review, a merge, a page to print or read large (960).

handle.$description: The grabber, the 36 x 4 bar at the top of a bottom sheet (Figma 25. Sheet Header: line/grid-dot, no radius). Re-declared from component.json, where it was 45% of the label ink.

compact-height.$description: The tallest a content-height bottom sheet gets: the screen less 48px (a percentage of a fixed box is of the screen it is fixed to, and unlike 100dvh never runs past a home-screen app's real height), so the page still shows above it. Past it the sheet's body scrolls. height="full" takes the whole screen instead. Re-declared from component.json, where it was a fixed 75dvh: Figma's sheets hug their content (Vale 05, Lockdown 11).

width.$description: PopoverContent's width: 320, so a PopoverHeader's overline, title and 44px close fit beside each other. It never outgrows the space on screen. Re-declared from component.json, where it was 18rem.

max-width.$description: The widest a tooltip gets before its text wraps. TruncatedText's full text wraps at it too (Synapse SNA3: between a least and a most width).

width.$description: A toast's width on a desktop. On a phone it spans the screen less its offsets.

offset.$description: How far toasts sit from the bottom left of the window when the frame gives no place for them. A frame sets --frame-toast-left and --frame-toast-bottom to put them at the bottom left of its content column (cross-app decisions §1), or above a phone's bottom row.

offset-compact.$description: The same on a phone, when the frame gives no place: the 16px page gutter.

gap.$description: The space between two toasts. The Toaster reads it once when it mounts, and falls back to 8px without the stylesheet.
